project: AI Video Cataloger - GUI Rebuild as CLI Wrapper
description: Rebuild the Electron GUI from scratch to be a thin wrapper over the CLI. The GUI will spawn CLI commands, display their output in a terminal-like log viewer, and provide a visual interface for browsing videos and their metadata.

userStories.title: Per-Folder Database Migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CLI to use per-folder databases instead of global
acceptanceCriteria: Each working folder has its own database
Existing global DB is not migrated (fresh start)
userStories.notes: Foundation for all other stories - enables per-folder processing

userStories.title: Bundle FFmpeg with CLI
userStories.description: As a user, I want CLI to work without system ffmpeg installed
acceptanceCriteria: Extract binary on first use to ~/.ai-video-cataloger/bin/
Fall back to system ffmpeg if bundled fails
Works on macOS arm64 and x64

userStories.title: Bundle Whisper.cpp with CLI
userStories.description: As a user, I want CLI to work without system whisper installed
acceptanceCriteria: Use bundled binary when whisper mode is 'local'
Fall back to system whisper if bundled unavailable

userStories.title: JSON Output Mode
userStories.description: As a developer, I want CLI to output JSON events so GUI can parse progress reliably
acceptanceCriteria: Output newline-delimited JSON for all commands
Include event types: started, progress, completed, error
Progress events include step name and percentage

userStories.title: Process Single Video Command
userStories.description: As a user, I want to process a single video file directly
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts same options as main command (--frames, --whisper, etc.)
Reports error if file doesn't exist or isn't video

userStories.title: Thumbnail Generation Command
userStories.description: As a user, I want CLI to generate video thumbnails
acceptanceCriteria: Skips if thumbnail already exists (use --force to regenerate)

userStories.title: Model Download Command
userStories.description: As a user, I want to download Whisper models via CLI
acceptanceCriteria: Downloads GGML model from Hugging Face
Shows progress with percentage and speed

userStories.title: Model Delete Command
userStories.description: As a user, I want to delete downloaded Whisper models
acceptanceCriteria: Reports error if model not downloaded

userStories.title: Config Get/Set Commands
userStories.description: As a user, I want to manage settings via CLI
acceptanceCriteria: Add config get [key] subcommand (all or specific)
Validates known keys and value types

userStories.title: Nested Database Check
userStories.description: As a user, I want CLI to detect nested databases
acceptanceCriteria: Main command refuses to run if nested DBs exist
Clear error message explaining the issue

userStories.title: Status with JSON Output
userStories.description: As a developer, I want status command to output JSON
acceptanceCriteria: Returns array of video records with status
Includes all fields: path, status, error, timestamps

userStories.title: Scan Folder Command
userStories.description: As a user, I want to list videos in a folder
acceptanceCriteria: Lists all video files with metadata (size, duration)

userStories.title: Prerequisites Check Command
userStories.description: As a user, I want to check system prerequisites
acceptanceCriteria: Checks: bundled ffmpeg, bundled whisper, claude CLI, ollama
Reports status and version for each
Shows bundled vs system for ffmpeg/whisper
Suggests installation steps for missing items

userStories.title: Delete Current Electron Code
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to remove the old GUI implementation
acceptanceCriteria: Update package.json to remove old electron scripts
Document what was removed in commit message

userStories.title: New Electron Scaffold
userStories.description: As a developer, I need fresh Electron project setup

userStories.title: Shadcn/ui Setup with macOS Theme
userStories.description: As a developer, I need UI components with macOS styling
acceptanceCriteria: Use SF Pro font (with system fallback)
Add base components: Button, Input, ScrollArea

userStories.title: CLI Spawner Service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need IPC to spawn and stream CLI output
acceptanceCriteria: Return process handle for kill capability
userStories.notes: Depends on US-066 - Core GUI-CLI bridge

userStories.title: Terminal Log Viewer Component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see CLI output in the GUI
acceptanceCriteria: Scrollable log area with monospace font
Auto-scroll to bottom on new output
Copy button to copy log contents

userStories.title: Basic Window Layout
userStories.description: As a user, I want a functional window layout
acceptanceCriteria: Three-panel layout: sidebar, main content, terminal log

userStories.title: Folder Picker with Nested DB Check
userStories.description: As a user, I want to select a folder to work with
acceptanceCriteria: Run ai-video-cataloger check on selected folder
If nested DBs found, show error modal with explanation
Show current folder path in UI
userStories.notes: Depends on US-061, US-068, US-070 - Final Phase 2 story

userStories.title: Video List with Thumbnails
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see videos in the selected folder
acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar shows list of video files
Call ai-video-cataloger scan --json to get list
Display thumbnail, filename, duration, status badge
Status badges: none (pending), yellow (processing), green (done), red (error)
userStories.notes: Start of Phase 3 - Depends on US-063, US-057, US-071

userStories.title: Video Details Panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see details of selected video
acceptanceCriteria: If completed: show summary, transcript preview, extracted frames
If error: show error message and failed step

userStories.title: Analyze Single Video
userStories.description: As a user, I want to analyze a video from GUI
acceptanceCriteria: Parse JSON events for progress indicator
Show progress bar with current step

userStories.title: Cancel Processing
userStories.description: As a user, I want to cancel ongoing analysis
acceptanceCriteria: Shows warning modal about potential incomplete state

userStories.title: Batch Processing
userStories.description: As a user, I want to analyze multiple videos
acceptanceCriteria: Analyze All button for pending videos
Processes videos one by one via CLI
Continue to next video on error

userStories.title: Settings Panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure processing options
userStories.notes: Depends on US-060 - Final Phase 3 story

userStories.title: Model Manager Panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to manage Whisper models in GUI
acceptanceCriteria: List available models with download status
Download button runs ai-video-cataloger models download --json
Delete button runs ai-video-cataloger models delete
userStories.notes: Start of Phase 4 - Depends on US-058, US-059

userStories.title: Prerequisites Panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see system status
acceptanceCriteria: Prerequisites panel accessible from Help menu

userStories.title: macOS Menu Bar
userStories.description: As a user, I want native macOS menus
acceptanceCriteria: File menu: Open Folder, Recent Folders, Close
View menu: Toggle Terminal Log, Zoom
Help menu: Prerequisites, Model Manager, About

userStories.title: AI Integration Tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to validate CLI output with AI
acceptanceCriteria: Runs CLI against BigBuckBunny test video
Uses Claude Code CLI to validate: frames extracted (images of animated characters), summary mentions 'Big Buck Bunny' and 'animated', status shows completed
